2856  SHRI SANJAY SETH: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government has received any proposal to increase the number of Self Help 
Groups (SHGs) in the States and if so, the details and the response thereof; 
(b)  whether Government proposes to lower the interest rate on the advances given to these 
groups and keep it at par with the interest rates charged on crop loans and if so , the 
details thereof; 
(c)  whether Government reviews the fund for SHGs from time to time and if so, the details 
thereof; and  
(d)  the other steps taken by Government to strengthen the SHGs?  
 
  
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SADHVI NIRANJAN JYOTI) 
 
 
(a)  The Ministry of Rural Development under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural 
Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) receives Annual Action Plans (AAPs) from States which 
includes physical targets for mobilization of rural poor women into Self Help groups (SHGs). 
The Annual Action Plans are approved by the Empowered Committee set up in the Ministry 
under the Chairmanship of Secretary (RD) for each financial year. The ultimate aim of DAY-
NRLM is to cover at least one woman member from each rural poor household (8-10 crore) 
under the fold of Self Help Groups (SHGs). All households with at least one deprivation as per 
the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) database and/or identified through the process of 
Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP) and vetted by the respective Gram Sabha are the 
potential target for coverage under DAY-NRLM. In the current Financial Year, up to 31 st 
January, 2021, against the target of 6.50 lakh SHGs, 4.71 lakh SHGs have been formed and 
cumulatively, 66.65 lakh SHGs have been formed across the country under DAY-NRLM. 
 
(b)  The Ministry of Rural Development under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National 
Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) is already providing Interest Subvention on loans 
taken by women Self Help Groups from Banks.  In 250 backward districts referred as 
Category-I districts, all women SHGs are eligible to get bank loans up to Rs. 3.00 lakh at an 
interest rate of 7% per annum. An additional Interest Subvention of 3% per annum is provided 
to women SHGs maintaining prompt repayment, reducing the effective rate of interest to 4%. 
465

This part of the scheme is implemented directly by Ministry of Rural Development and funded 
entirely out of the central component under DAY-NRLM.  
In the remaining districts of the country referred to as Category-II districts, women SHGs 
under DAY-NRLM availing loans up to Rs. 3.00 lakh from Banks  are given Interest 
Subvention to the extent of the difference between Bank’s lending rate and 7% subject to the 
maximum ceiling of 5.50% per annum. This part of the scheme is implemented by respective

ISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT

 (a) Under Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY), no trainings

 e allocated to States as per

budget allocation for training of SC and ST candidates.  The Government is committed to 
provide requisite fund to State Government of Assam for the betterment of STs in the State as 
per the guidelines of the scheme. 
    
(d)&(e) To reduce drop outs at later stage of placement, DDU-GKY focuses on right 
mobilization of candidates according to the skilling courses & jobs aspirations. Psychometric 
tests are also a part of the selection process followed with counseling of candidates wherein 
prospective trainees are made aware of the nature of work in the sector/trade, availability of jobs, 
employer expectations, entitlements, growth prospects and risks involved. This is aimed at 
helping both candidates and parents to make informed choices and to match aptitude with 
aspirations. The quality of candidates mobilized has a significant impact on retention during 
training and in placement too. DDU-GKY incentivizes long duration placement by adopting 
following incentives based on area and duration of placement: 
467

1. Post Placement Support (Placement within District of domicile incentive for 2 months/ 
Placement within State of domicile Incentive for 3 months/ Placement outside State of domicile 
incentive for 6 months) 
 
2. Retention Support @ Rs. 3000 /- per candidate  
 
An additional payment is being made available to the Project Implementation Agency (PIA), at 
the rate of Rs. 3000/- per person retained in employment for 365 days. Out of the retention 
support cost, 1/3rd of the Support cost is to be shared by PIA with the Candidate i.e. Rs. 1000/-  
is to be paid to candidates and Rs. 2000/- is to be retained by the PIA. 
 
3. Career Progression @ Rs. 5000 /- per candidate

trained by the PIA who crosses a salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month and holds it for a minimum of 
90 calendar days within one year of completion of training. Out of Career Progression support 
cost, 1/3rd of the Support cost is to be shared by PIA with the Candidate i.e. Rs. 1,667/- is to be 
paid to candidates and Rs. 3,333/- is to be retained by the PIA. 
 
4. Mobile Tracking Support for Candidates @50 /- per month for 12 months  
 
5. Further for ensuring skilling outcomes, residential trainings are being conducted, which helps

(c) PMGSY envisages a three tier Quality Assurance Mechanism  to ensure quality of road 
works during construction. The first two tiers of the structure are the responsibility of the respective 
State Governments and under the third tier, NRIDA engages independent National Quality Monitors 
(NQMs) for inspections at random, of the road works under the programme.  
 
469

NRIDA has issued general guidelines and prescribed quality assurance hand books to 
regulate the quality control process at works level. Guidelines have also been issued for inspections 
of works by independent monitors under the second and third tier of the quality assurance 
mechanism. To make the inspections trustworthy, it is being ensured that independent monitors at the 
second and the third tier take at least 10 digital photographs including one of the field laboratories, 
for each work and upload it on Online Monitoring, Management and Accounting System 
(OMMAS) website to facilitate public viewing of quality of road works executed under the 
programme.  Based on the experience gained, these guidelines have been reviewed and revised from 
time to time.  A synopsis of the work carried out at each level of monitoring mechanism is detailed 
below: 
   
Under the 1st tier of quality control  mec hanism, the quality standards are enforced through 
in-house mechanism by establishing field laboratories and carrying out mandatory tests. In addition, 
to augment the field laboratories for non-frequent tests, state and district laboratories have been 
promoted in all States.  As per the Programme Guidelines, a site quality control laboratory has to be 
set up by the contractor for each package. Payments are not made to the contractors unless quality 
control laboratory has been set up. 
   
Under the second tier , independent monitoring of quality at the State level has been 
prescribed under the control of SRRDA.  The SRRDA is required to monitor the quality of works by 
deploying State Quality Monitors (SQMs), independent of the implementing units and upload the 
abstract of quality grading along with photographs in OMMAS.  These quality monitors check the 
establishment of field laboratories also. As per guidelines, each road work is inspected by the State 
Quality Monitors at three different stages. The first two inspections of every work should be carried 
out during the execution of work spaced at least three months apart and the last inspection should be 
carried out on the completion of every work, as soon as possible but preferably within 4 months of 
completion of the work.   
   
The third tier of the quality mechanism is an independent monitoring system at the central 
level. Under this tier, retired senior engineers termed as National Quality Monitors (NQMs) are 
engaged for inspections of road works.  Works for inspection are selected at random.  The basic 
objective of this tier is to identify generic issues in quality assurance mechanism of the State. Also 
these provide on-site guidance to field staff for better understanding of specifications and good 
construction practices.   
   
The NQM grades the work inspected in three categories viz. Satisfactory(S), Satisfactory 
Requiring Improvement (SRI) and Unsatisfactory (U). The States are required to send Action Taken 
Reports (ATRs) in respect of works graded as ‘Satisfactory Requiring Improvement’ and 
‘Unsatisfactory’ by the NQMs during their field inspections. These ATRs are further processed at 
NRIDA and a decision about grade improvement is taken based on documentary proof including 
photographs of road work and recommendation of the SRRDA. The entire exercise of submission of 
ATRs by the States and taking of action on these ATRs has now been facilitated in the form of an 
“online process” on OMMAS.   
 
Besides, in order to bring transparency & accountability in the maintenance of roads under 
Defect Liability Period (DLP), e-MARG has been implemented and all the States are on board e-
MARG as on date. e-MARG is a GIS-based Enterprise e-Governance solution to aid and assist the 
officials, Contractors, Banks and general public. It is an end-to-end solution, which provides role-
based access via internet.  e-MARG focuses on upkeep of PMGSY roads in all circumstances, hence 
entails performance based evaluation of roads for making maintenance related payments of PMGSY 
roads that are under DLP.

(a)  to (c): The Ministry of Rural Development is implementing various schemes/programmes to 
bri
ng about overall improvement in the quality of life of the people in rural areas of the country 
including the State of Rajasthan through employment generation, strengthening of livelihood 
opportunities, promoting self-employment, skilling of rural youths, provision of social assistance 
and other basic amenities. The details of the schemes/programmes implemented by the Ministry 
of Rural Development along with the physical and financial progress in the State of Rajasthan 
are given below:- 
  
(i)  Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme:  The principal 
objec
tive of the scheme is to provide for the enhancement of livelihood security of the 
households by providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in every 
financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled 
manual work. It stresses on creation of durable and sustainable assets to make the 
beneficiaries self-dependant.

  crore person-days have been 
generated and an amount of Rs. 7916 crore  has been released in the current FY 2020-21 
under Mahatma Gandhi NREGS.  Around 1200575 numbers of permitted works have been 
taken up under the scheme in the State as on 16.03.2021 in the FY 2020-21.  
471

(ii) Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-
NRLM): The Ministry is implementing DAY-NRLM  across the country since 2011 in a 
mission mode with the objective of organizing the rural poor women into Self Help Groups 
(SHGs) and continuously nurturing and supporting them to take economic activities till they 
attain appreciable increase in income over a period of time to improve their quality of life 
and come out of abject poverty. Besides, Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme 
(SVEP), a sub-scheme under DAY-NRLM, has the objective of helping Self Help Group 
(SHG) and their family members to set-up small enterprises at the village level in the non-
farm sector.  
 
 Dur i
ng the current FY 2020-21(as on 28.02.2020), a total of Rs.132.19 crore has been 
relea
se under NRLM in the State of Rajasthan. As on 31 st January 2021, DAY-NRLM is 
bein
g implemented in 295 blocks of 33 districts of Rajasthan. A total of 21.70 lakh rural 
households have been mobilised into 1.87 lakh Self Help Groups (SHGs) and further 
federated into 14400 Village Organisations (VOs) and 469 Cluster Level Federations 
(CLFs). A total of Rs. 931 crore of capitalisation support (Revolving Funds and 
Community Investment Funds) has been provided to SHGs and their federations towards 
extending the credit to SHG Members so far. As on 31 st January, 2021, under SVEP, 
Ente
rprise formation has started in 5 blocks and 5448 enterprises have been formed so far. 
  
(iii) Deen  Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen KaushalyaYojana (DDU-GKY) and Rural Self 
Employment and Training Institutes (RSETIs ):  Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen 
Kaush
alya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is the placement linked skill development programme for 
rural poor youth under NRLM being in operation since September, 2014 . Skill development 
through Rural Self Employment and Training Institutes (RSETIs) is also being undertaken to 
enable a trainee to take bank credit and start his/her own Micro-enterprise. Some of such 
trainees may also seek regular salaried jobs. Both the above mentioned schemes are aimed at 
increasing employability of rural poor youth either for wage or self employment leading to 
economic and social development of youth of rural area of the country by removing the 
hurdles of the rural livelihooods and by strengthening rural economy and rural income.  
 
During the current FY 2020-21(as on 28.02.2021), a total expenditure (including State 
share) of Rs. 48.39 crore has been incurred and 359 candidates have been trained and 1374 
candidates have been placed under DDU-GKY in the State of Rajasthan. Under RSETI, 
during the current FY 2020-21 (as on 28.02.2021),  a total fund of Rs. 4.37 crore has been 
release and a total of 16547 candidates have been trained and 8387 candidates have been 
settled under RSETI in the State of Rajasthan.  
  
(iv) Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G): PMAY-G aims to provide a 
pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in 
kutcha and dilapidated house by 2022. To achieve the objective of “Housing for All”, the 
target number of houses to be constructed by the year 2021-22, is 2.95 Crore. In the State of 
Rajasthan, during the current FY 2020-21, as on 16.03.2021, a total of Rs.1108.58 crore has 
been spent (as per Expenditure Control Register in Rajasthan), and 433306 houses are 
targeted for construction and 57740 houses have been completed under the scheme. 
(v) Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):  PMGSY was started in the year 
2000 with the objective to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected 
habitations. The mandate of the scheme was subsequently widened and new interventions 
viz. PMGSY-II and PMGSY-III were added for upgradation of the existing rural road 
472

network which connect habitations to the various facilities and services. The implementation 
of the ongoing PMGSY has helped immensely in lifting the socio–economic conditions of 
rural masses by providing them access to the various services and facilities, market place 
and employment opportunities in various forms.  
 
A total of 75,332 km of road length has been sanctioned to the State of Rajasthan under 
various interventions/verticals of the scheme, of which 68,197 km of road length has been 
completed and an expenditure of Rs.13,306 crore has been incurred. 
 
 (vi) Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Rurban Mission (SPMRM):   The Shyama Prasad 
Mukherji Rurban Mission (SPMRM) launched in February 2016, is a scheme with the 
objective to stimulate local economic development, enhance basic services, and create well 
planned Rurban clusters. The mission takes cluster as a unit for development. 300 Clusters 
from all the States/ UTs are selected in the first phase of the Mission in Tribal and Non-
Tribal categories. SPMRM provides the Critical Gap Funding to the projects which directly 
or indirectly bring economic growth. SPMRM aims to provide amenities in four categories 
viz Basic, Economic, Social and Digital and promotes economic growth through integrated 
and balanced investments with social inclusion. The programme is under implementation 
stage.  
For the State of Rajasthan, out of 16 clusters, approval of the Ministry for Integrated Cluster 
Action Plan (ICAP) has been given for 15 clusters, planning notification has been done for 
15 clusters and Detailed Project Report (DPR) approval by State Level Empowered 
Committee (SLEC) has been done for 15 clusters.  Out of the proposed 6542 number of 
works, 1027 works have been completed and 198 works are ongoing.  A total of Rs.1373.37 
crore investment has been approved for Rajasthan and an expenditure of Rs.705.63 crore has 
been made including convergence and Critical Gap Fund (CGF). 
(vii)  Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY):   Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana 
(SAGY) was launched on 11 October 2014. Under the SAGY framework, the development 
of Gram Panchayats is envisaged through effective convergence and implementation of 
existing development Schemes of Government under the administrative control of respective 
Ministries without allocation of any additional fund.  
 
 
(d)  There is no proposal under consideration to launch special programme under the Schemes of 
MoRD in the State of Rajasthan. However, this Ministry had implemented National Rural 
Livelihoods Project (NRLP)  from July 2011 to June 2018, which facilitated in establishing 
DAY-NRLM’s “proof-of-concept” in 13 high poverty states including Rajasthan (Assam, Bihar, 
Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Odisha, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar 
Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal) by helping in development of implementation 
architecture, initiating social mobilization and capacity building, providing capitalization support 
and establishing credit linkage with Banks. Considering the emerging priorities of the Mission, 
the Ministry of Rural Development initiated the implementation of the next phase of the project, 
viz. National Rural Economic Transformation Project (NRETP) in the same 13 States with focus 
on strengthening federations of women Self Help Groups, forming livelihoods collectives under 
farm and non-farm sectors and focus on digital finance and risk coverage. The fund released 
under NRETP to Rajasthan for the year 2020-21 (upto February 2021) is Rs.3.93crore.

2862  SHRI RAMKUMAR VERMA: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government has any data with regard to the houses constructed under 
Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) in the last five years, if so, the 
district-wise details for the State of Rajasthan; 
(b)  how many applications are pending with Government under PMAY-G, the district-
wise details for the State of Rajasthan and the action taken by Government for early 
sanctioning of houses; and 
(c)  whether Government has any plan to cover those families in the scheme who are 
eligible for PMAY-G but not listed in 2011 census, if so, the details thereof and if not, 
the reasons therefor?  
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SADHVI NIRANJAN JYOTI) 
 
 
(a) Yes Sir. In order to achieve the objective of “Housing for All”, the erstwhile rural 
housing scheme Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY) has been restructured into Pradhan Mantri 
Awaas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G) w.e.f. 1 st April, 2016.  PMAY-G aims to construct 2.95 
crore
 houses by 2022 to achieve its target. The District-wise total number of houses 
constructed in the State of Rajasthan from Financial Year 2016-17 to 2020-21 (as on 
15.03.2021) under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G) is given at Annexure. 
 
(b) The selection of beneficiaries under PMAY-G is done on the basis of 
deprivation/exclusion criteria on the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC), 2011 data 
followed by verification by Gram Sabhas and appellate process thereafter. A Permanent Wait 
List (PWL) of eligible beneficiaries is thus generated.  No further addition is allowed in the 
PWL of any State.  In view of yearly allocation of targets given by this Ministry, the PWL of 
the State of Rajasthan has already been saturated.  
 
(c) In order to identify those households who though are eligible for assistance under 
PMAY-G (as per the parameters specified under SECC-2011) but are not included in the list 
of eligible beneficiaries i.e. PWL, an exercise was conducted by Ministry of Rural 
Development through the States / UTs using Mobile Application “Awaas+”, thus generating 
an additional list of 3.57 crore households.  The Union Cabinet while approving continuation 
of PMAY-G had given approval for inclusion of additional eligible households from the final 
Awaas+ list into the PWL of PMAY-G, with a ceiling of 2.95 Crore.

DECLINE IN DEMAND FOR JOBS UNDER MGNREGA 
 
2865  SHRI MALLIKARJUN KHARGE: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether there has been any decline in demand for jobs under the MGNREGA over 
the last three months; 
(b)  if not, the reason the allocation for MGNREGA was slashed by 34.5 per cent as 
compared to the Revised Estimate for 2020-21; and  
(c)  the alternate plans for providing employment to the people in rural areas 
available with Government, despite reducing the allocation for MGNREGA?  
 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SADHVI NIRANJAN JYOTI) 
 
 
 
(a)     Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (Mahatma Gandhi 
NREGS) is a demand driven wage employment programme which provide for the 
enhancement of livelihood security of the households in rural areas of the country by 
providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year 
to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work. 
 
The number of households who demanded work in the last three months of financial year 
(FY) 2020-21 under Mahatma Gandhi NREGA has increased by 40% with reference to the 
corresponding period of FY 2019-20.  The month-wise number of households who demanded 
work under Mahatma Gandhi NREGA in the last three months of FY 2019-20 and FY 2020-
21 is given below. 
 
Households Demanded Work (in lakh) 
  FY 2019-20 FY 2020-
21 Increase 
December 170.50 265.23 56% 
January 188.93 263.05 39% 
February 222.68 286.67 29% 
Total 582.12  814.94 40% 
 
486

(b) & (c)  The Government of India has allocated Rs. 73,000 crore as Budget Estimate (BE) 
for next FY 2021-22 for Mahatma Gandhi NREGA with an increase of Rs. 11,500 crore 
(18.69%) as compared to Budget Estimate for FY 2020-21.  
 
Mahatma Gandhi NREG Act 2005 entitles hundred days of guaranteed wage employment to 
every rural households in a financial year whose adult members agree to do unskilled manual 
work. Additionally, the Act also provides for additional 50 days of unskilled wage 
employment in a financial year in drought/ natural calamity notifies rural areas. As per 
Section 3(4) of the Mahatma Gandhi NREG Act, 2005, the State Governments may make 
provisions for providing additional days of employment beyond the period guaranteed under 
the Act from their own funds. Further, Mahatma Gandhi NREGS is a demand driven wage 
employment programme and Central Government is committed to making funds available to 
the States/ UTs for the implementation of the Scheme. The Ministry seeks additional fund for 
the Scheme as and when required for meeting the demand for work on the ground. During 
the FY 2020-21, the Government enhanced the B.E. of Rs. 61,500 crore to Rs. 1,11,500 crore 
for better implementation of the Scheme. 
 
Further, there are two skill development programmes for rural poor youth under DAY-
NRLM, namely, Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY), and 
Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETIs). Both these schemes are aimed at 
increasing employability of rural poor youth either for wage or self-employment. After 
unlock orders and opening of training centres, under DDU-GKY a total of 20946 candidates 
have been trained and 44338 candidates have been placed in jobs during the current financial 
year 2020-21 (upto February, 2021). Under RSETI a total of 203643 candidates have been 
trained and 127108 candidates have been settled during the current Financial Year 2020-
21(up to February, 2021). 
 
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) is a one-time special intervention of 
Government of India to provide rural connectivity, by way of a single all-weather road, to the 
eligible unconnected habitations in the core network. A study on Impact of PMGSY roads on 
accessibility was done by BITS, Pilani, the findings of which  suggests that the PMGSY 
roads have provided new opportunities of employment in nearby urban areas where people 
can commute daily. 
To pursue the objective of ‘Housing for All by 2022’ the erstwhile rural housing scheme 
Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY) has been restructured into Pradhan Mantari Awaas Yojana-G 
(PMAY-G) with effect from 1 st April 2016. The target under PMAY-G is construction of 
2.95 
crore pucca houses with basic amenities for eligible rural households by March, 2022. 
As per the framework of Implementation of PMAY-G, it is mandatory to provide support of 
90 person-days ( 95 person-days in hilly states, difficult areas and IAP districts) unskilled 
wage employment at the current rates to a PMAY-G beneficiaries for construction of his/her 
house in convergence with Mahatma Gandhi NREGA. 
 
The implementation of PMGSY and PMAY-G generates direct and indirect employment in 
rural areas of the country.

areas during 2020-21 could not be achieved during COVID-19 pandemic; 
(b)  if so, whether Government proposes to boost the construction of houses for rural poor 
and to achieve the targets during 2021-22; and 
(c)  if so, the details thereof?

MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT

allocation of targets to the States/UTs under PMAY-G, provision of adequate funds and 
promotion of eco-friendly and innovative  technologies  for  house  construction,  provision  
of  land  to  landless  beneficiaries in rural areas, regular review of progress at the level of 
Secretary/Additional Secretary/Deputy DG, Ministry  of  Rural  Development  and  separate

PMKVY IN RAJASTHAN 
 
2871. SHRI NEERAJ DANGI: 
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a)      the number of people who have been trained under the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal 
Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) during the last three years, year-wise and district-wise; 
 
(b)      the amount of funds allocated to the State of Rajasthan under the said scheme 
during the last three years, year-wise; 
 
(c) the number of people who have received training and employment under the said 
scheme; and 
 
(d) whether any study or analysis has been done keeping in mind the training being 
imparted in the said scheme and the needs of the people of Rajasthan, if so, the details 
thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R. K. SINGH) 
 
(a) and (c) Under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) 2.0 during the last 
three years (FY 2017-18 to 2019-20), 87.39 lakh candidates have been trained / 
oriented across the country including 7.51 lakh candidates in the State of Rajasthan. 
The district-wise number of candidates trained/oriented in the State of Rajasthan under 
PMKVY 2.0, as on 19.01.2021, is given at Annexure. 
  
Under placement-linked Short Term Training (STT) component of PMKVY 2.0, as 
on 19.01.2021, out of 36.04 lakh certified candidates, 18.95 lakh candidates have been 
placed across the country. Similarly, in the State of Rajasthan, out of 2.82 lakh certified 
candidates in STT, 1.51 lakh candidates have been placed. 
  
(b)       PMKVY has two components namely; Centrally Sponsored Centrally Managed 
(CSSM) and Centrally Sponsored State Managed (CSSM). CSCM component does not 
have provision of State-wise allocation of funds. While under CSSM component of 
PMKVY 2.0, out of total revised allocation of Rs. 70.96 crore, Rs. 26.19 crore has been 
released to the State of Rajasthan based on their training performance. 
  
(d)      Under the PMKVY scheme, sector-wise and state-wise Skill Gap studies are 
conducted by National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), based on which the 
training plan is made. This has been further decentralized under PMKVY 3.0, where 
District Skill Committees have been entrusted with the task of identifying local demand, 
based on which training is arranged in the district.

UNEMPLOYED YOUTH TRAINED FOR SKILL DEVELOPMENT 
 
2872. SHRI M. SHANMUGAM: 
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased to state: 
 
(a)      the number of unemployed youth trained for skill development under the Pradhan Mantri 
Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY);  
 
(b)      the number of Kaushal Vikas Kendras running in the State of Tamil Nadu, district-wise;  
 
(c) the type of technical skill development facilities available to the youth ;  
 
(d) whether any job opportunities are being provided to these trainees after the training ; and  
 
(e) whether there is a demand for more such Kendras in various district and if so, the response of 
Government thereto? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R. K. SINGH) 
 
(a) Under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 2.0 (PMKVY), as on 19.01.2021, 1.07 crore 
(approx) candidates have been trained/oriented across the country. 
  
(b)       Under PMKVY 2.0, 1,081 Training Centres (TCs)  have been empanelled in the State of Tamil 
Nadu. Out of these; 30 TCs are running as on 19.01.2021 in the State of Tamil Nadu. The district-
wise number of empanelled Training Centres (TCs) under PMKVY 2.0 in State of Tamil Nadu, as on 
19.01.2021, is given at Annexure. 
  
(c)        Under PMKVY 2.0, training is being imparted in 1,800 NSQF aligned job roles of level 3 to 5 
including technical courses across 37 sectors. 
  
(d)       Yes, Sir, placement opportunities are being provided to candidates certified under placement-
linked Short Term Training (STT) component of PMKVY 2.0.  Under placement -linked Short Term 
Training (STT) of PMKVY 2.0, as on 19.01.2021, 36.04 lakh candidates have been certified; out of 
which, 18.95 lakh candidates have been placed in diverse sectors. Further, Recognition of Prior 
Learning (RPL) does not mandate placement as it orients and certifies candidate with prior learning 
experience or skills. 
  
(e)       Ministry has designed third phase of PMKVY, i.e., PMKVY 3.0, as a demand-driven scheme 
with bottom-up approach for identification and mapping of job roles. Targets to districts in various job 
roles are being allocated based on the demand shared by the respective District Skill Committees 
(DSCs). Training centres are being empanelled under the scheme on the basis of demands in various 
job roles of the respective district.

COMMUNICATION MECHANISM TO CREATE AWARENESS 
 
2876     SHRI SURENDRA SINGH NAGAR: 
  
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is planning to bring in any commu
 nication mechanism to 
be adopted at various levels to create awareness about need for skill development at 
local, State, district and village levels; 
 
(b) whether Government is considering to adopt State Skill Development Mission 
(SSD
M) to organize advertisement campaigns in local language through electronic 
and print media; 
 
(c) whether any steps are being taken at school level to create awareness about 
voca
tional education, apprenticeship, etc., if so, details thereof; and 
 
(d) whether Government has entered into any partnership with international 
agencies for vocational training opportunities and if so, details thereof? 
 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP  
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a):  The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) periodically 
engages with the media and does advocacy with regard to skill development and its 
relevance to the current market demand, through Rojgar Melas, Kaushal Mahotsav, 
counselling sessions for youth, interactive sessions and activities, panel discussions, 
Kushal Yuva Samvaad  and also through events to celebrate their success, 
achievements and milestones.  Success case studies of students who have been 
able to transform their lives through skill development are also propagated to inspire 
others to hone a skill of their choice.  
 
A central repository is maintained by the Ministry which enables the flow of 
information regarding schemes, programs, events and initiatives. Government 
channels, events, platforms, symposiums and webinars are also utilized to 
communicate skill development initiatives and activities. Partnerships in the field of 
skilling with other Central Ministries, States, Corporate, Academia, etc. are also 
promoted with the help of offline and online media. Extensive social media outreach 
is done with periodic on-ground activation to widen the reach of skill development in 
the country. Further, various organizations under the Ministry like the National Skill 
Development Corporation (NSDC), Directorate General of Training, National Institute 
514

for Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development (NIESBUD) and Indian 
Institute of Entrepreneurship (IIE) create awareness at their respective levels.   
(b):  The Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) 3.0, launched on 
15.01.2021, is focused on making skill development more demand-driven and 
decentralized in its approach, in order to empower the youth with new-age skills and 
to enhance their employability. The scheme is being implemented with the State and 
District authorities working through the State Skill Development Missions (SSDMs) 
and the District Skill Committees (DSCs). The States have been allocated budgets 
for promotion of the scheme and given full authority to utilize the funds for adopting 
the communication outreach, which works best at local level. 
 
(c):  The Department of School Education and Literacy under the Ministry of 
Education is implementing the scheme of Vocationalisation of School Education 
under the umbrella of ‘Samagra Shiksha - an integrated scheme for school 
education’, a Centrally Sponsored Scheme. The Scheme seeks to integrate 
vocational education with general academic education with an aim to prepare 
educated, employable and competitive human resource for various sectors of the 
economy. Vocational courses are taught to the students of class 9 th to 12 th who opt 
for 
vocational subject in the schools covered under the scheme. Vocational 
Education has been approved in 12,854 Secondary and Senior Secondary Schools 
under the Scheme. Further, the Central Board of Secondary Education offers 
vocational courses at secondary and senior secondary levels in its affiliated schools. 
The National Institute of Open Schooling also runs vocational courses up to higher 
secondary level. In order to create awareness, the State Governments concerned 
organizes media publicity from time to time as per need. In addition, experimential 
learning in schools, being undertaken by NSDC through short training modules, 
industry visits, apprenticeships ( Internshala), and guest speakers from industry, also 
helps in creating awareness. 
 
(d):   MSDE is implementing a program titled, Skill Acquisition and Knowledge 
Awareness for Livelihood Promotion (SANKALP), with partial loan assistance taken 
by the Government of India from the World Bank. The program is aimed at improving 
short-term skill training qualitatively and quantitatively by strengthening institutions, 
bringing in better market connectivity and inclusion of marginalized sections of the 
society. Workshops under the SANKALP program are being done to acquaint 
stakeholders at the district level with the nuances of skill development. In addition, 
the Government of India has been actively engaging with other countries including 
Japan, United Arab Emirates and Switzerland, aimed at knowledge sharing, capacity 
building for the Indian Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) 
system, and facilitating international workforce mobility of skilled and certified Indian 
workers.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2878 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 19.03.2021 
 
IMPACT OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT COURSES 
 
2878  SHRI AYODHYA RAMI REDDY: 
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether any study has been conducted to asses the impact of skill 
development courses on the employability of people and the difference skill 
development has made to the people who got skilled, if so, the details thereof; 
 
(b)  whether there is any scheme through which people without any formal 
education but with skills in various fields are provided with skill certificates after 
proper assessment; 
 
(c)  the total number of skill development centres in the country ; and 
 
(d)  the measures taken by the Central Government to further popularise the skill 
development programmes? 
 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a)  Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is the flagship scheme of the 
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), being implemented 
through the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). PMKVY provides for 
skill training mainly through Short-Term Training (STT) and Recognition of Prior 
Learning (RPL). PMKVY has been launched in three phases viz. PMKVY 1.0 (2015-
16), PMKVY 2.0 (2016-2020) and PMKVY 3.0, which was launched on 15.01.2021. 
NSDC had engaged Sambodhi Research and Communications to conduct a third-
party evaluation Study of PMKVY 2.0 to assess the impact of the program on the 
employability and income of its participants or beneficiaries in a holistic manner. The 
Sambodhi Study found that the mean monthly income of individuals trained and 
certified under PMKVY 2.0 – STT was 15 percent higher when compared to a 
comparison group of individuals who has not participated in PMKVY. Further, the 
average monthly income of RPL-certified individuals was found to be 19 percent 
higher than that of a comparison group of non-RPL certified individuals. 
 
(b)  The RPL component of PMKVY, which recognizes existing skills through 
orientation, and Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) Scheme of the Ministry do not 
mandate any formal education before undertaking training/ orientation in short-term 
skilling. Certification is done after completion of assessment. 
 
517

(c) Under PMKVY, training is imparted through empanelled Training Centres 
(TCs) and Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKKs). As on 19.01.2021, 14,353 
TCs have been empanelled and 738 PMKKs established. Further, 229 Jan Shikshan 
Sansthans are functional in 25 States and 3 Union Territories. In the long-term 
training eco-system, there are 14,813 Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) functioning 
in the country as of 10.03.2021.  
 
(d) The various steps taken by the Ministry to popularise the skill development 
programmes, inter-alia, include the following: 
  
o MSDE has allocated adequate funds to State Skill Development Missions 
(SSDMs) under PMKVY 3.0 for promotion of the scheme and has given full 
authority to utilize the funds for adopting the communication outreach, which 
works best at local level.  
 
o MSDE engages periodically with the media and does advocacy with regard to 
skill development and its relevance to the current market demand, through 
Rozgar Melas , Kaushal Mahotsav , and counseling sessions for youth, 
interactive sessions and activities, panel discussions, Kushal Yuva Samvaad  
and also through events to celebrate their success, achievements and 
milestones. 
 
o MSDE, through the NSDC, organizes skill competitions such as IndiaSkills 
which are conducted across state, regional and national levels to make skills 
aspirational for youth.   
 
o Further, various organizations under the aegis of MSDE viz. NSDC, 
Directorate General of Training, Indian Institute of Entrepreneurship, and 
National Institute of Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development 
(NIESBUD) also create awareness at their respective levels.

JOBS THROUGH SKILL DEVELOPMENT SCHEMES 
 
2879  Dr. Vikas Mahatme: 
 
Will
 the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURS HIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a) the number of youngsters that got jobs through the s chemes run by the 
Ministry; 
 
(b) whether the Ministry has a facility for providing jobs geographical and sector-
wise; and  
 
(c) if so, the details thereof? 
 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
    
(a) to (c) The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is 
implementing a number of schemes to impart employable skills to people belonging 
to different geographies, sectors and strata of the population. The Ministry is 
implementing Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), Jan Shikshan 
Sansthan (JSS) Scheme and National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) for 
short-term skill training in various sectors and Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) 
through the Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) for long-term training. Under the Short-
Term Training component of PMKVY 2.0 (2016-2020), as on 19.01.2021, 18.95 lakh 
candidates have been reported placed in jobs under various sectors. Recognition of 
Prior Learning Component of PMKVY, JSS, NAPS and CTS do not have placement 
as a criteria. Further, the Ministry through the National Skill Development Corporation 
has launched the Aatmanirbhar Skilled Employee Employer Mapping (ASEEM) portal 
to help skilled people find sustainable livelihood opportunities. As on 05.03.2021, 
1.29 crore skilled personnel have been on-boarded on the portal and around 8.4 lakh 
job offers have been made.

2880  DR. SASMIT PATRA:  
  
           Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
(a) the evidence that shows there has been growth in entrepreneurship in India; 
 
(b) the challenges faced in developing entrepreneurship in India;  and 
 
(c
)    the reasons for high levels of unemployment persisting despite efforts to improve 
entrepren
eurship in India? 
  
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R. K. SINGH) 
(a):   According to Economic Survey 2019-2020, India ranks third in number of new firms 
created and the new firm creation has gone up dramatically in India since 2014. While the 
number of new firms in the formal sector grew at a cumulative annual growth rate of 3.8 per 
cent from 2006-2014, the growth rate from 2014 to 2018 has been 12.2 per cent. As a result, 
from about 70,000 new firms created in 2014, the number has grown by about 80 per cent to 
about 1,24,000 new firms in 2018.       
  
(b):   Some of the challenges faced by entrepreneurs in Micro, Small and Medium (MSME) 
sector, as categorized  by the ‘Expert Committee on Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises’ 
constituted by Reserve Bank of India(June 2019),  are lack of formalization, lack of timely 
payments to MSMEs, absence of backward and forward infrastructural linkages, lack of 
access to formal credit & equity support, limited access to market, information 
asymmetry, lack of managerial, legal and technical know how, etc. 
  
(c):    As per the Annual Periodic Labour  Force Survey (PLFS) for 2017-18 and 2018-19 
done by National Statistical Office (NSO), Ministry of Statistics and Programme 
Implementation, the estimated unemployment rate (state-wise) to the extent available for 
persons of all ages on usual status (principal status + subsidiary status) basis in the country, 
is given at Annexure-I. Thus, it is seen that the unemployment in the country has gone 
down from 6.1% in 2017-18 to 5.8% in 2018-19.

ननय ुक्त राज्य िाइसेंलसंग  प्राधधकाररयों द्िारा िाइसेंसीकरण और ननर क्षण पद्धनत क े  माध्यम से 
औषध एिं प्रसाधन सामग्री अधधननयम एिं ननयमािि  1945 क े  प्रािधानों क े  तहत विननयलमत ककया

प्राधधकाररयों को ऐसे िाइसेंसों की ककसी शतय क े  उल्िंघन पर कारयिाई करने का अधधकार होता है

संगठन (सीडीएससीओ) और स्िास््य एिं पररिार कल्याण मंत्रािय ने देश में औषधधयों की ग ुणित्ता 
सुननजश्चत करने क े  लिए समय -समय पर विलभ्न उपाय ककए हैं।

2771. श्री इरण्ि कडाडड:  
क्या वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे ककिः

(ख)  यदि हााँ, तो तत्संबंधी जिला -वार ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(ग)  क्या सरकार ने औद्योगगक पवकास और इन पपछडे जिलों/क्षेत्रों में स्थानीय संसाधनों के आधार पर 
उद्योग स्थापपत करने के ललए कोई नीतत , अनुक ूल पररजस्थततयां, तनवेश तंत्र अथवा योिना बनाई

(क) और (ख): िी, हााँ।  कनााटक सरकार ने अपनी नई औद्योगगक नीतत 2020-25 बनाई है , जिसमें 
औद्योगगक पपछडेपन के आधार पर , 152 ताल ुकों को िोन -1 के रूप में वगीक ृत ककया

िोन में आने वाले उद्योगों को अलग -अलग प्रोत्साहन और ररयायतें िी िा रही हैं। िोन-3 
की त ुलना में िोन-1 और िोन -2 में आने वाले उद्योगों को अगधक प्रोत्साहन और 
ररयायतें िी िा रही हैं।  जिलेवार पववरण  अन ुबंर् में संलग्न है।            
(ग) और (घ): िी हााँ, कनााटक सरकार ने नई औद्योगगक नीतत - 2020-25 की घोषणा की है।

प्रोत्साहन और ररयायतें िी िा रही हैं।

उपभोक्ता मामले , खाद्य और सार्वजनिक नर्तरण मंत्रालय 
उपभोक्ता मामले नर्भाग  
 
राज्य सभा 
अताराांकित प्रश्न सांख्या 2790    
 
किसिा उत्तर शुक्रवार 19 मार्च, 2021  िो किया िाएगा  
 
िौहररयों द्वारा अत् यककि िममत वसल
  किया िाा ा  
 
2790 श्री ए. कवियिु मार:  
 
क् या उोभोक् ता माम  , खाद्य और सावचिका ि कवतरण मांत्री यह बतािे की क ृपा करेंगे नक:  
 
(क)  क् या सरकार को  स बात की जािकारह हक नक जरहरह सोिे के ूभ णोणप पर ्‍ यनकक ‘मेनक ंग और 
र्ेस् टेज राजव’ र्स णल रहे हैं;  
(ख)  यनि हां, तो क् या सरकार का ूभ णोण ‍ यापार को स ्‍ यर्नस्तत करिे का को  ्रसस् तार् हक ;  
(ग)  यनि िहीं, तो  सके क् या कारण हैं ;  
(घ)  क् या सरकार ूभ णोण की ि ्कािप पर ग ्णर्ता ा जां
र महटर रखा जािा ्निर्ायव करेगह ; और  
(ड.)  यनि िहीं, तो  सके क् या कारण हैं ? 
उत्तर 
उोभोक्ता माम  , खाद्य और सावचिका ि कवतरण राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री िाा व  रावसाह ब िािाराव) 
 
 
(क):   जह, िहीं।  
 
(ख) और (ग): उपरोक् त (क) के स ंिभव में ्रस्‍ ि िहीं उतता।  
 
(घ) और (ड.): जह, िहीं। हाला ंनक , सरकार िे स् र्णव ूभ णोणपककलाक ृनतयप की ्निर्ायव हॉलमानकिंग के नलए

(ि)   क्या सरकार नूडल् स, क ु रक ु रे, र्टपटा, वेफसच आलद जैसे स् थानीय ब्रैंड क े  पैक लकए गए लवलभ न् न छोटे

लनधाचररत मानकों और मानदंडों की लनयलमत र्ौकसी, लनगरानी, लनरीक्षण और यादृद्धच्छक नमूने क े  माध्यम से

(ि) से (ख) खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की एक अम्‍ब रैला 
स् कीम – प्रधान मंत्री लकसान सम्‍ब पदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) को क ृ लि उत् पाद प्रसंस् करण सलहत खाद्य 
प्रसंस् करण क्षेत्र की समग्र वृद्धि एवं लवकास हेतु कायाचद्धित कर रहा है । इस स् कीम में विच 2016-17 से 
2019-20 की अवलध क े  ललए 6,000 करोड़ रुपए का पररव् यय है । इस अवलध को लवत् त विच 2020-21 
तक बढा लदया गया है । पीएमक े एसवाई की र्टक स् कीमें हैं-  (i) मेगा फ ू ड पाक च, (ii) एकीक ृ त शीत 
श्ृंखला एवं मूल् यवधचन अवसंरर्ना, (iii) खाद्य प्रसंस् करण एवं परररक्षण क्षमता सृजन/लवस् तार (iv) क ृ लि-
प्रसंस् करण क् लस् टर अवसंरर्ना, (v) बैकवडच एवं फारवडच ललंक े ज सृजन (vi) खाद्य संरक्षा एवं गुणवत् ता 
आश् वासन अवसंरर्ना, (vii) मानव संसाधन एवं संस् थान, (viii) ऑपरेशन ग्रीन् स ।  
 पीएमक े एसवाई की र्टक स् कीमों में एमओएफपीआई अलधकांशत:  उद्यलमयों को खाद्य 
प्रसंस् करण/परररक्षण उद्योग स् थालपत करने क े  ललए क्रेलडट ललंक् ड लवत् तीय सहायता (प्रारंलभक पूंजी) 
अनुदान सहायता क े  रूप में प्रदान करती है । पीएमक े एसवाई कोई क्षेत्र या राज् य लवलशष् ट नहीं हैं परंतु, 
मांग आधाररत है और इसे उत् तर प्रदेश क े  ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों सलहत पूरे देश में कायाचद्धित लकया जाता है । 
अभी तक मंत्रालय ने उत् तर प्रदेश में पीएमक े एसवाई की संगत र्टक योजनाओं में 23 कोल् ड र्ेन

उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(ि) से (ड.) खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की एक अम् रैला स् कीम – 
प्रधान मंत्री लकसान सम् पदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) को क ृ लर्ष उत् पाद प्रसंस् करण सलहत खाद्य प्रसंस् करण क्षेत्र की 
समग्र वृद्धि एवं लवकास हेतु कायाचद्धित कर रहा है । इस स् कीम में वर्षच 2016-17 से 2019-20 की अवलध क े  ललए 
6,000 करोड़ रुपए का पररव् यय है । इस अवलध को लवत् त  वर्षच 2020-21 तक बढा लदया गया है । 
पीएमक े एसवाई की घिक स् कीमें हैं-  (i) मेगा फ ू ड पाक च, (ii) एकीक ृ त शीत श्ृंखला एवं मूल् य वधचन अवसंरर्ना, 
(iii) खाद्य प्रसंस् करण एवं परररक्षण क्षमता सृजन/लवस् तार (iv) क ृ लर्ष-प्रसंस् करण क् लस् िर अवसंरर्ना, (v) बैकवडच 
एवं फारवडच ललंक े ज सृजन (vi) खाद्य संरक्षा एवं गुणवत् ता आश वासन अवसंरर्ना, (vii) मानव संसाधन ए वं 
संस् थान, (viii) ऑपरेशन ग्रीन् स ।  
 पीएमक े एसवाई की घिक स् कीमों में एमओएफपीआई अलधकांशत: उद्यलमयों को खाद्य प्रसंस् करण और 
परररक्षण अवसंरर्ना क े  साथ-साथ खाद्य प्रसंस् करण यूलनिें स् थालपत करने क े  ललए ि े लडि ललंक् ड लवत् तीय सहायता 
(पूंजीगत सद्धिडी) अनुदान सहायता क े  रूप में प्रदान करती है । पीएमक े एसवाई कोई क्षेत्र या राज् य लवलशष् ि 
नहीं हैं परंतु, मांग आधाररत है और इसे उत् तर प्रदेश सलहत पूरे देश में कायाचद्धित लकया जाता है । अभी तक 
मंत्रालय ने उत् तर प्रदेश में पीएमक े एसवाई की घिक योजनाओं में 23 कोल् ड र्ेन पररयोजनाए ं, 3 क ृ लर्ष-
प्रसंस् करण क् लस् िर, 22 खाद्य प्रसंस् करण यूलनिें, 6 बैकवडच एवं फारवडच ललंक ेज सृजन पररयोजनाए ं  और 9 खाद्य 
परीक्षण प्रयोगशाला पररयोजनाए ं  अनुमोलदत की है । इन पररयोजनाओं का लववरण साथ में स् वीक ृ त और अभी 
तक जारी अनुदान सहायता सांलग् नि में दी गई है ।

 डा.नरेन् र जाधव:  
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योर् मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष् म खाद्य उद्योग उन् नयन योजना (पीएमएफएमई) क े  अंतगचत लकतने लकसान उत् पादक संगठन 
स् वयं सेवी समूह और उत् पादक सहकारी संस् थाऍं  लाभान्न् वत हुई हैं, इसका राज् य-वार ब् यौरा क् या है;  
(ख)  इस योजना क े  अंतगचत उन् नयन क े  ललए लकतने मौजूदा सूक्ष् म खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योगों को लवत् तीय, प्रौद्योलगकीय 
और व् यापाररक सहायता प्रदान की गई है, प्रदान की गई सहायता का राज् य-वार ब् यौरा क् या है;   
(र्)  योजना क े  अंतगचत कौशल प्रलशक्षण, खाद्य सुरक्षा, मानकों और स् वच् छता संबंधी तकनीकी ज्ञान प्रदान करने तथा 
गुणवत् ता सुधार क े  ललए अब तक कौन-कौन से क्षमता लनमाचण उपाय लकये गये हैं; और  
(घ) योजना क े  अंतगचत राज् य-वार आंवलित लनलध का लकतना उपयोग लकया गया है?    
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योर् राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(ि) और (ख):  पीएमएफएमई स् कीम को मंलत्रमंडल द्वारा मई, 2020 में अनुमोलदत लकया गया था और स् कीम क े  
लदशालनदेशों को जून 2020 में जारी लकया गया था । मंत्रालय ने व् यन्िगत सूक्ष् म खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्यमों से आवेदन 
प्रस् तुत करने क े  ललए एमआईएस पोिचल का शुभारंभ 25 जनवरी, 2021 को लकया था । 16 मार्च, 2021 की न्स्थलत क े  
अनुसार 1534 आवेदन प्रस् तुत लकए गए हैं । लडन्र ि क ररसोसच पसचन/ लडन्र ि क लेवल कमेिी संबंलधत राज् यों/संघ शालसत 
क्षेत्रों में आवेदनों की जांर् कर रही है ।  
समूह अथाचत एसएर्जीज, एफपीओज और सहकाररताओं क े ललए पूंजी लनवेश क े  ललए ऑनलाइन आवेदन 
मॉड्यूल लवकास क े  र्रण क े  अंतगचत है । ऑफलाइन आवेदनों को 07 जनवरी, 2021 से आमंलत्रत लकया गया है । प्रस् तुत 
आवेदनों/अनुमोलदत क े  लववरणों को राज् यों और संघ शालसत क्षेत्रों द्वारा अभी अंलतम रूप लदया जाना है ।  
करीब 40,000 एसएर्जीज सदस् य जो खाद्य प्रसंस् करण में शालमल  हैं की एसआरएलएम द्वारा प्रारंलभक पूंजी क े  
ललए पहर्ान की गई है । एसआरएलएम एसएर्जीज सदस् यों क े  लववरणों की जांर्/प्रमाणन कर रहा है । स् कीम क े  
लदशालनदेशों क े  अनुसार एसएर्जीज सदस् यों को एसआरएलएम की लसफाररश क े  आधार पर प्रारंलभक पूंजी क े  ललए 
समथचन उपलब् ध कराया जाएगा ।  
(र्): अभी तक स् कीम क े  अंतगचत लनम् नललन्खत क्षमता लनमाचण उपायों को आरंभ लकया गया है:- 
i. क्षमता लनमाचण पर लवस् तृत लदशालनदेशों को नवम् बर, 2020 में जारी लकया गया था ।   
ii. 35 राज् यों/संघ शालसत क्षेत्रों क े  राज् य स् तर तकनीकी संस् थानों (एसएलिीआई) को मंत्रालय द्वारा अनुमोलदत 
लकया गया है ।  
iii. 334 मास् िर ि िेनरों का प्रलशक्षण ईडीपी और लवलभन् न खाद्य उत् पादों पर आयोलजत लकया गया ।  
iv. 9 राज् यों में 177 लजला स् तर क े  ि िेनरों को प्रलशलक्षत लकया गया ।  
v. लनफ्टेम और आईआईएफपीिी ने ि िेलनंग मॉड्यूल (ओडीओपी) तैयार लकए हैं जो एमओएफपीआई, लनफ्टेम 
और आईआईएफपीिी की वेबसाइिों पर प्र कालशत लकए गए    हैं ।  
(घ): स् कीम क े  अंतगचत राज् य और संघ शालसत क्षेत्र-वार जारी लनलधयों का लववरण सांलग् नि में लदया गया है  ।

2815   श्री अहमद अशफाि िरीम:  
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा कर ें गे लक:  
(ि)   र् ंलक लबहार उद्योग की दृष्‍ ि से एक लप छडा राज् य है, तो क् या लबहार राज् य में खाद्य प्रसंस् करण 
उद्योग लगाने की कोई योजना है; और   
(ख)  यलद हां, तो तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है? 
 
उत्तर 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(ि) से (ख):  खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) लकसी भी खाद्य प्रसंस्करण 
उद्योग/य लनिों/पररयोजनाओं को स्वयं स्थालपत नही ं  करता है। तथालप, यह 14वें लवत् त आयोग क े  र्क्र 
(2016-17 से 2019 -20) की अवलध क े  ललए 6 ,000 करोड रुपये क े  पररव्यय क े  साथ क े  खाद्य 
प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र की समग्र वृष्ि और लवकास क े  ललए क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र अम्ब्रेला स्कीम-प्रधानमंत्री लकसान 
संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) को कायाचष्ित कर रहा है। इस अवलध को अब लवत्त वर्च 2020-21 
तक बढा लदया गया है। पीएमक े एसवाई की घिक योजनाओं क े  अतंगचत एमओएफपीआई खाद्य 
प्रसंस्करण/परर रक्षण उद्योगों की स्थापना क े  ललए उद्यलमयों को अनुदान  सहायता क े  रूप में 
अलधकांशत: क्र े लिि ललंक्ि लवत्तीय सहायता (प ंजीगत सष्ििी) प्रदान करता है । पीएमक े एसवाई कोई 
क्षेत्र अथवा राज्य लवलशष्ट नही ं  है बष्ि मांग आधाररत है और इसे लबहार  राज्य सलहत देश भर में 
कायाचष्ित लकया जाता है ।  अभी तक एमओएफपीआई ने राज् य में पीएमक े एसवाई की संबंलधत घिक 
स्कीमों क े  अतंगचत एक मेगा फ  ि पाक च, 6 कोल् ि र्ेन पररयोजनाए ं, एक क ृ लर्-प्रसंस् करण क् लस् िर और 
एक खाद्य प्रसंस् करण इकाई अनुमोलदत की है ।  
आत्म लनभचर भारत पहल क े  भाग क े  रूप में एमओएफपीआई 2020-21 से 2024 -25 तक 
पांर् वर्ों क े  दौरान क्र े लिि ललंक्ि सष्ििी क े  माध्यम से 2 लाख स क्ष् म खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्यमों की 
स्थापना/उन्नयन क े  ललए लवत्तीय, तकनीकी और व्यावसालयक सहायता प्रदान करने क े  ललए क ें द्र 
प्रायोलजत स् कीम-प्रधानमंत्री स क्ष् म खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्यम उन् नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योजना को 10,000 
करोड रुपए क े  पररव् यय क े  साथ कायाचष्न् वत कर रहा है  ।  इसमें से लबहार  को अगले पांर् वर्ों क े  ललए 
469.73 करोड रुपये क े  पररव्यय क े  साथ क ु ल 10261 य लनिें आवंलित की गई हैं।

2816.  डा. कििय पी.सहस्‍त रबुद्धे:  
 
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस्‍त िरण उद्योर् मांरी यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)   क् या मंत्रालय ने आत् मलनभचर भारत अलभ यान पैक े ज क े  अंतगचत एफपीआई को बढावा देने क े  ललए कोई प्रमुख 
योजनाए ं /नीलतयां/कदमों की शुरूआत की है , तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है;  
(ख)  यलद ह ं, तो मंत्रालय द्वारा आत् मलनभचर भारत अलभ यान पैक ेज को बढावा देने क े  ललए कायाचन्‍ वत की गई नीलत यों 
और योजनाओं की वतचमान न्‍ िलत क् या है; और   
(र्)  ऐसी योजनाओं से लाभान्‍ वत होने वाले प्रमुख लहतधारकों का तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है?

कित्तीय प्रर्कत: 
प्रिम पूरक क े  अंतगचत 150 करोड़ रुपये आवंलटत लकए गए हैं , लजनमें से 123.15 करोड़ रुपये (राज्-110.28 करोड़,

    पंचायती राज मंत्री

(क) से (ड.): पंचायती राज मंत्रालय ने वर्षच 2012-13 से 2015-16 के िौरान राजीव गांिी पंचायत

सशजक्तकरर् असभयान (सीबी -पीएसए) कायाचजन्‍दवत ककया और अब प ुनचगदित राष्ट्रीय ग्राम स्वराज 
असभयान (आरजीएसए) को वर्षच 2018-19 से उत्तर प्रिेश राज्य  सदहत  िेश में कायाचजन्‍दवत कर रहा है 
जजसमें में पंचायती राज सं स्र्ानों में तनवाचधचत प्रतततनधियों और अन्‍दय पिाधिकाररयों के क्षमता तनमाचर् 
के प्रमुख उद्िेश्यों सदहत पंचायती राज संस्र्ानों (पीआरआई) को मजबूत करना शासमल है।  ककसी जजले 
को नहीं अपपत ु राज्यों को तनधि सीिे जारी की जाती है। पपतिले 5 वर्षच के िौरान उपरोक्त स्कीमों  के 
तहत सहायता अन ुिान के रूप में उत्तर प्रिेश राज्य को कुल 342 करोड़ रुपये जारी ककए गए हैं जजसमें 
से  190.80 करोड रूपए माचच 2020 तक  अव्यतयत रहे हैं।

पंचायतों के प्रोत्साहनीकरर् स्कीम के तहत, पंचायती  राज मंत्रालय सभी तीनों स्तरों पर सवचश्रेष्ट्ि 
प्रिशचन करने वाली पंचायतों को प्रत्येक वर्षच आयोजजत होने वाली पुरस्कार प्रततयोधगता की  पवसभन्‍दन 
श्रेणर्यों में उनकी भागीिारी के आिार पर सहायता अनुिान जारी करता  है। पपिले पांच वर्षों के िौरान, 
उत्तर प्रिेश राज्य ने 204 प ुरस्कार जीता जजसके सलए  20.93 करोड़ रूपए जारी ककए गए हैं । 
  
    इसके अलावा , पपिले पांच वर्षों के िौरान उत्तर प्रिेश राज्य में ग्राम पंचायतों के सलए चौिहवें पवत्त
